biological_story.headline: NTRK2 shifts from a proximal shorter-coding terminal group in Astro/NSCs to the distal MANE/full-length-like terminal group in mature neurons
biological_story.interpretation_guard: terminal-group usage is not molecule-level isoform phasing

ntrk2.role: exploratory structure-aware validation of the protocol-aware PolyASite mixture result

semantics.claim: PolyASite candidates adjacent to GENCODE coding transcript ends; not molecule-level isoform phasing
semantics.full_group_rule: the unique terminal group containing the GENCODE MANE Select transcript
semantics.short_group_rule: upstream GENCODE Primary group with shorter median CDS and greatest coding-transcript support
semantics.site_assignment_rule: nearest terminal group within 2000 bp; ties resolve by distance then genomic order
semantics.terminal_group_rule: coding transcript endpoints single-link clustered within 5000 bp

confirmatory_status: the preregistered global effect-size gate failed and is not rescued
